AMAG Austria Metall AG Names New Chief Operating Officer Amid Growth Strategy

AMAG Austria Metall AG, a leading player in the Austrian metals and mining sector, has announced the appointment of Dr. Petra Leitner as its new Chief Operating Officer, effective July 1. The appointment comes as the company seeks to advance its operational efficiency and expand its market presence in Europe.

Dr. Leitner joins the executive board with over two decades of experience in metallurgical engineering and operations management, most recently serving as Head of Production at the Vienna-based industrial group Alpex Stahlwerke. She holds a PhD in Materials Science from the University of Graz.

“We are delighted to welcome Dr. Leitner to our leadership team,” said Helmut Wiesinger, CEO of AMAG Austria Metall AG, in a statement on Tuesday. “Her deep industry knowledge and proven track record in streamlining production processes will be essential as we continue to pursue our growth strategy and further strengthen our position as a supplier of high-quality aluminium products.”

The appointment was well received by industry observers. “This is a strong signal that AMAG is committed to operational excellence and innovation,” said Sophie Maurer, an analyst at the Vienna Metals Exchange. “Dr. Leitner’s expertise in lean manufacturing and sustainability initiatives aligns well with current market trends and regulatory requirements.”

The Austrian Metals & Mining Federation also welcomed the move. “AMAG is a pillar of the domestic industry, and strengthening its management is positive for the sector,” said Federation President Markus Egger. “We look forward to seeing the company’s continued investment in advanced technologies and workforce development.”

AMAG Austria Metall AG reported revenues of €1.3 billion in 2023, with exports accounting for over 70% of its sales. The company recently completed a €40 million upgrade of its Ranshofen facility, focusing on automation and environmental performance.

Dr. Leitner stated, “I am excited to join AMAG at such a dynamic time and look forward to working with the team to drive innovation and sustainable growth.”
